# Networking & Spatial Sync Requirements Quality Checklist: World & Movement

**Purpose**: Kiểm định chất lượng yêu cầu cho phân vùng thế giới, di chuyển server-authoritative và đồng bộ mạng (`003-world-movement`).
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Spatial & Movement Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK001 Are collision grid sharing requirements between server validation and client prediction explicitly specified to avoid reconciliation rubber-banding? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the three reconciliation error thresholds (`< 6 px`, `6–48 px`, `> 48 px`) unambiguously defined? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Are Spatial Hash Grid cell dimensions (`256x256 px`) and interest window (`5x5` cells) explicitly quantified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Are Private Homestead idle unload rules (`60 seconds` empty → flush JSON → unload RAM) clearly specified? [Completeness, Spec §US2]

## Sync, Recovery & Persistence Alignment

- [ ] CHK005 Is the prohibition against writing JSON position updates on every 20 Hz tick explicitly enforced alongside the 30-second dirty-flush and transition-flush policy? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Constitution §IV]
- [ ] CHK006 Are delta-packet loss recovery (`SNAPSHOT_RESYNC_REQ`) and disconnect safe-spawn fallback (`lastSafeZoneId/X/Y`) requirements clearly documented? [Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK007 Are day/night cycle duration (`24 min`), season length (`14 game-days`), and region-wide weather synchronization rules consistent with `docs/game-design/12-farming-system.md`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Are speed-hack and teleport-cheating server checks specified without trusting client-provided destination coordinates? [Security, Spec §FR-003, Constitution §II]
